title: Product Truth
description: Authoritative facts + creative constraints for one product, consumed by AI generators before prompt-building. DRAFT v0.1.0.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier, referenced by the routine model and briefs.

role.description: The product's single job, in plain language.

sides.description: For multi-function products, each functional side/mode.

hero_action.description: The single action a shot should centre on.

never_show.description: Hard prohibitions. A brief that depicts any of these fails validation.

canonical_reference.description: Which repo image(s) authoritatively define the product's appearance.

claims.description: Every usable customer-facing claim, each traced to its source.

open_questions.description: Unresolved conflicts or gaps for a human to settle before status can advance to 'approved'.
